<documents>
<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
PowerˆofˆattorneyˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆforˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember,ˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteamˆcanˆaddˆyouˆtoˆtheirˆaccountˆasˆanˆagent.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆneedˆ-ˆAˆcopyˆofˆtheˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆdocument,ˆsignedˆandˆinˆeffectˆ-ˆYourˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆYourˆcontactˆdetailsˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆitˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆPowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆaskˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆtoˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheirˆsession.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreviewˆtheˆdocuments.ˆTheyˆgoˆtoˆAccountˆServices.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆconfirmˆwhatˆtheyˆreceived,ˆandˆmayˆaskˆforˆmoreˆinformation.ˆ##ˆUntilˆit'sˆapprovedˆWeˆcan'tˆshareˆinformationˆorˆtakeˆinstructionsˆfromˆyouˆuntilˆAccountˆServicesˆhasˆapprovedˆtheˆdocument.ˆThatˆincludesˆfreezingˆcardsˆorˆchangingˆplans.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆbeingˆexploitedˆfinancially,ˆtellˆus.ˆWeˆtreatˆthatˆasˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-merchant-v2">
DisputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchantˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆforˆsomethingˆwithˆyourˆcardˆandˆthere'sˆaˆproblemˆwithˆtheˆpurchaseˆitself,ˆyouˆcanˆfileˆaˆmerchantˆdispute.ˆThisˆcovers:ˆ-ˆItemsˆorˆservicesˆyouˆpaidˆforˆbutˆneverˆreceivedˆ-ˆItemsˆthatˆwereˆsignificantlyˆdifferentˆfromˆwhatˆwasˆdescribedˆ-ˆSubscriptionsˆorˆrecurringˆchargesˆthatˆcontinuedˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆ##ˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirstˆBeforeˆyouˆdispute,ˆtryˆtoˆsortˆitˆoutˆwithˆtheˆmerchant,ˆandˆkeepˆaˆrecordˆofˆwhatˆyouˆsentˆandˆwhatˆtheyˆsaid.ˆWe'llˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆFileˆaˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆweˆcan'tˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfileˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆProblemˆwithˆaˆpurchase.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆuploadˆyourˆrecords.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆthenˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetwork.ˆMostˆcasesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆTransactionsˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆatˆallˆareˆaˆdifferentˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-what-we-can-do">
WhatˆourˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆhelpˆwithˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆcanˆsortˆoutˆmostˆthingsˆduringˆyourˆchat.ˆSomeˆrequestsˆgoˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteam,ˆandˆaˆfewˆthingsˆweˆcan'tˆdoˆatˆall.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcanˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆReportˆaˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆandˆorderˆaˆreplacementˆ-ˆOpenˆaˆdisputeˆthat'sˆinsideˆitsˆwindow,ˆhasˆposted,ˆandˆtotalsˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆRefundˆaˆfeeˆunderˆourˆrefundˆpolicyˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆplanˆ-ˆCloseˆyourˆaccountˆifˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆzeroˆandˆnothingˆisˆpendingˆorˆdisputedˆ-ˆExplainˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆpoliciesˆ##ˆSupportˆpassesˆtoˆaˆspecialistˆteamˆ-ˆ**Fraud:**ˆsuspectedˆaccountˆtakeover,ˆremovingˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆscamˆpaymentsˆ-ˆ**Disputes:**ˆdisputesˆaboveˆtheˆsupportˆlimitˆ-ˆ**Verification:**ˆidentityˆchecks,ˆlegalˆnameˆorˆdate-of-birthˆchanges,ˆaccountsˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆ-ˆ**AccountˆServices:**ˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆaˆdeceasedˆaccountˆholder,ˆfinancialˆabuseˆ-ˆ**Complaints:**ˆformalˆcomplaintsˆSpecialistˆteamsˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆSupportˆcan'tˆ-ˆActˆfor,ˆorˆshareˆdetailsˆwith,ˆanyoneˆotherˆthanˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆ-ˆGiveˆinvestment,ˆtaxˆorˆlegalˆadviceˆ-ˆRaiseˆlimitsˆ-ˆRefundˆfeesˆoutsideˆtheˆrefundˆpolicy,ˆorˆopenˆdisputesˆafterˆtheirˆwindowˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
